discussion_comments.comment_body:
In cases like this, I would rather clean up the product and delete the line from the documentation. Or fix the product and keep it.

Reason is, it looks silly to document something that does nothing. Why did we document this thing that does nothing, and not other things?

It would be different if we indicated it does X, caveat, it is broken right now. That implies it WILL do that thing again soon...

TBH if something was broken enough for us not to notice for a long time, and isn't a core part of the product, it is probably a good sign we should remove it. I am OK if you nominate some PRs you want fixed in a certain direction and block landing the doc update on those PRs resolving. Only exception is cases where that's a ton of complicated work, in that case, we have to keep moving forward and we should document the caveats and fix them asynchronously. This is presumably not that scale of issue.)

## JSON Output Format
 
-When using `--json`, each message is a JSON object on its own line:
+With `--json`, the CLI prints one JSON object per line. Every line has a `type` and a `ts` (an ISO 8601 timestamp):
 
 ```json
-{"type": "say", "text": "I'll create the file now.", "ts": 1760501486669, "say": "text"}
+{"ts":"2026-10-07T04:49:43.041Z","type":"agent_event","event":{"type":"done","reason":"completed","text":"Hello!","iterations":1}}
 ```
 
-| Field | Type | Description |
-|-------|------|-------------|
-| `type` | `"ask"` or `"say"` | Message category |
-| `text` | `string` | Message content |
-| `ts` | `number` | Unix timestamp in milliseconds |
-| `say` | `string` | Subtype when `type` is `"say"` |
-| `ask` | `string` | Subtype when `type` is `"ask"` |
-| `reasoning` | `string` | Model reasoning (if available) |
-| `partial` | `boolean` | `true` while streaming |
+| `type` | Description |
+|--------|-------------|
+| `agent_event` | An event from the agent, in `event`. `event.type` is one of the [agent events](/sdk/reference/events#agentevent): `content_start`, `content_update`, `content_end`, `iteration_start`, `iteration_end`, `usage`, `notice`, `done` or `error` |
+| `hook_event` | A lifecycle hook ran (`hookEventName`, `agentId`, `taskId`) |
+| `team_event` | An event from an [agent team](/cli/agent-teams), in `event` |
+| `run_result` | The run finished: `finishReason`, `iterations`, `usage`, `durationMs`, `model` and the final `text` |
+| `run_aborted` | Follows `run_result` when the run was stopped (`reason`, `message`) |

+
+# Restart a connector, with the options you started it with

discussion_comments.comment_body: Right: `connect` passes everything after the channel to the connector, so `--restart` never reached it, and the same was true of `--stop`. Fixed in 225657908. Both examples now put the option before the channel, and the reference says why.
